record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Dynamical Systems
record.original_question: For a generic smooth Hamiltonian H on the energy surface H^{-1}(1), are the invariant probability measures supported on periodic orbits dense, in the weak topology, in the set of ergodic minimizing measures?

evidence.quote: For the C∞-generic H on H−1(1) are the probability measures defined by periodic orbits, dense (in the weak topology on probability measures) in the ergodic minimal measures ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed smooth manifold and let $H: T^*M \to \mathbb{R}$ be a smooth Hamiltonian whose energy surface $\Sigma := H^{-1}(1)$ is a regular, compact level set, generating a Hamiltonian flow $\phi_t$ on $\Sigma$. Recall that an invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ on $\Sigma$ is called a minimizing (Mather) measure if it minimizes the action $\int L\, d\mu$ over all $\phi_t$-invariant probability measures on $\Sigma$, where $L$ is the Lagrangian dual to $H$ on the corresponding energy level; let $\mathcal{M}_{\min}^{\mathrm{erg}}(H)$ denote the set of ergodic minimizing measures, viewed as a subset of the space of Borel probability measures on $\Sigma$ with the weak-* topology. For each periodic orbit $\gamma$ of $\phi_t$ on $\Sigma$, let $\mu_\gamma$ denote the unique invariant probability measure supported on $\gamma$.

Question: Is it true that for a $C^\infty$-generic smooth Hamiltonian $H$ (i.e., for $H$ in a residual subset of $C^\infty$ Hamiltonians for which $H^{-1}(1)$ is a regular compact energy surface), the set
$$\{\mu_\gamma : \gamma \text{ is a periodic orbit of } \phi_t \text{ on } H^{-1}(1)\}$$
is dense, in the weak-* topology, in $\mathcal{M}_{\min}^{\mathrm{erg}}(H)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a long-standing problem in Aubry–Mather theory / ergodic optimization (Mañé-type genericity). Partial results are known in related settings: for generic Lipschitz potentials over expanding maps and certain symbolic systems, maximizing/minimizing measures are typically supported on a single periodic orbit (resolutions of forms of the Mañé conjecture), and recent work continues to address typical periodic optimization. However, no proof is known that resolves the question for $C^\infty$-generic smooth Hamiltonians on a fixed energy surface, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Joint typical periodic optimization
status_evidence.snippet: There exist open dense sets of Lipschitz functions such that each member has a unique maximizing measure and this measure is periodic.
status_evidence.claim: Periodic optimization (Mañé-type) results are established in symbolic/expanding settings, but not for generic smooth Hamiltonians.

status_evidence.title: Dense periodic optimization for countable Markov shift via Aubry points
status_evidence.snippet: Dense periodic optimization is studied for countable Markov shifts via Aubry points.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research focuses on density of periodic measures among optimizing measures, but in symbolic dynamics rather than generic smooth Hamiltonians.

status_evidence.title: Sorrentino — Aubry-Mather Theory survey
status_evidence.snippet: Mather measures and the structure of the Mather/Aubry sets remain a central object of study.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys of Aubry–Mather theory list density of periodic measures in the set of minimizing measures as an outstanding question.
